text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day while searching for Air Shakur, I
find her taking a rare nap,
her laptop still
open.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I go to close her laptop, the screen
catches my eye. It looks like
she had her
social media open. The account on-screen
says "!monad."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From the looks of it,
this is an account she
uses to post music she makes. I'm a little
surprised by her choice of hobby, but
decide to leave before she wakes up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I decide to invite Air
Shakur to the record shop.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I fully expected her to say no,
but it seems she already had plans to
come here. She's
allowed me to tag along—but nothing
more.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Man, you never learn, huh. Remember
what happened at the net
cafe?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Once we're at the shop, don't you dare
talk to me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
This artist's not even that big, so why a
physical CD? If they'd just
posted it
online, I could've bought it with a single
click.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems she's come here today to buy the
CD of a small-time artist.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Not really.
But it is good for drowning out
the thoughts in my head.

text_block_list.name: Young Artist
text_block_list.text: Next up is my newest song, "Rust."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur stops in her tracks.
I follow her
line of sight to find a young
woman
performing on her DJ deck.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Her CD is what I came here to buy.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Didn't think I'd get to listen to her live
today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, Air Shakur finds a spot a bit
separated from the artist and
begins to
listen to her performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The song's rhythm seems to draw you in,
and the scat vocals add a sense of
playfulness to the experience. Before I
know it, I'm tapping
my foot to the beat.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, it's not bad.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Most of her stuff online is really light
and
old school... Looks like she
switched
genres to house music.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Well,
change is inevitable after all. Let's
get going.

text_block_list.name: Young Artist
text_block_list.text: W-wait! Please take this!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The young musician hands a single flyer to
Air Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Young Artist
text_block_list.text:
I'm still pretty new to the game,
but I'll be
performing at this event!
Feel free to drop
by if you can!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Got it.
Huh, so it's this weekend—ah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taking a peek at the flyer, my eyes settle
on the artist's profile, which
explains she
was inspired to perform after hearing a
certain artist... !monad.

text_block_list.name: Young Musician
text_block_list.text: Um, 'scuse me... is everything okay?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it's fine. Good luck this weekend.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hey!

text_block_list.name: Young Artist
text_block_list.text:
Oh, them! I love, love, LOVE !monad's
stuff! I have to be extra careful
to not
copy their style completely.

text_block_list.name: Young Artist
text_block_list.text:
I ended up using scat vocals hoping to
make the song feel mine... But well, I'm
definitely still working out the kinks
in my
style!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...!monad's music sounds like they're just
messing around to me. I
doubt it's got any
use as inspiration or whatever.

text_block_list.name: Young Artist
text_block_list.text:
Hey, come on, don't say that! I owe
!monad my life!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Your life?

text_block_list.name: Young Artist
text_block_list.text:
I don't mean that literally or anything.
It's
not like we've ever met.
But...

text_block_list.name: Young Artist
text_block_list.text: I'm just... different from other people, and my life's been pretty hard 'cause of it. But even when I tried to fit in, it's like something was still off, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Young Artist
text_block_list.text:
But that's when I heard !monad's music,
and it felt like someone was sticking the
middle finger to the world! It gave me the
push I needed
to do things my way!

text_block_list.name: Young Artist
text_block_list.text:
But all that aside, their musical sense
alone is on another level! They're like a
bat out of hell, screaming bloody murder!
They're truly
living in the moment!

text_block_list.name: Young Artist
text_block_list.text: I'd love to meet them myself one day. I just know that deep down, they've got a heart burning with passion!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? What're you smiling about?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Several days later...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look at this! Someone put a super
flashy flyer on the bulletin
board! You
think a student did it?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Probably. But wait,
isn't this for a club in
town? Huh... Maybe I'll
check it out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A mysterious flyer posted on the school
bulletin board quickly
becomes the talk of
the academy.
